I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message. I confirmed I've noted that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats, and that I'm not taking any action, as he asked.

I also suggested he correct his post in #central-team, since people there may have read the wrong number. I didn't open #central-team, so I'm going on his word that the wrong number is posted there. Seat counts count as account facts rather than finance figures, so I didn't need anyone's approval to reply.
